correctness.rationale: Let e=k-k_m and D=e(0)=T_m/Z, V=integral e(x)^2 dx=S_m/Z^2. Haar orthogonality gives exact E F=N D^2+N(N-1)V. For distinct unordered (i,j), squared offdiagonal terms sharing an index have zero covariance conditional on that shared point by translation invariance. Thus Var F=2N(N-1)(integral e^4-V^2)<=2N(N-1)D^2 V and rel Var <=2q/[N(1+q)^2]<=1/(2N), q=(N-1)V/D^2. Bounded N sequences concentrate because q=O(N m^-d), unbounded N via Chebyshev; full arbitrary oscillating N(m) follows. Lattice-tail Riemann sums yield T~t m^-2nu, S~s m^-(4nu+d), hence crossover N~m^d and ratio s/t^2=1/6 for d1,nu=.5.
residual_risks: Finite checks establish only their stated finite domains; infinite conclusions depend on analytic argument.

Periodic Matérn sampling theory covers a related underlying spectral construction but not this same random Gram-matrix statistic.
